description: Machine-readable redaction policy for IM2A v2.5.0 trajectory data. Patterns are detection rules, not credentials. No dataset key, token, or sample value is stored here. A class that cannot be detected automatically is marked manual_review and blocks dataset freeze until a named reviewer signs it off.

keyHandling.storage: KMS/HSM per dataset; never in manifest, repository, logs, or evidence bundles
keyHandling.rotation: new dataset_key per dataset version; linkage only through a separately approved linkage_id

classes.rationale: Credential material. Redaction of the value is not enough: the surrounding record must be discarded and the pipeline run alarmed.

classes.description: Bearer tokens, API keys, and cloud access-key prefixes
classes.rationale: Same as authCode: a leaked token in a training set is an incident, not a redaction count.

classes.description: IM2A public UID (user code plus agent subcode)
classes.rationale: The public code is also the login credential (privacy review F-01) and its space is enumerable, so a bare hash is reversible. Use HMAC under the dataset key.
Same as publicUid; must not survive as a bare hash.

classes.description: 12-digit IM2A-number-shaped string; over-redacts non-Luhn strings by design (fail closed)
classes.rationale: Enumerably small space (about 10^10); pseudonymize with HMAC, never a bare digest.
Direct contact identifier; placeholder keeps turn structure without the value.
Government identifier; never trainable in any form.
Third-party identity; HMAC under the dataset key.
Stable device fingerprint; drop the value.
URLs can carry tokens, intranet topology, or document ids.

classes.description: IPv4 address (including private and test ranges)
classes.rationale: Network fingerprint. False positives on version strings are accepted; fail closed.

classes.description: Absolute Windows or POSIX file path
classes.rationale: Paths reveal usernames, project names, and mounted volumes.
Session references are linkable; keep only a hash if linkage is required.

classes.description: Names, kinship terms, places, and amounts that can re-identify a subject
classes.rationale: Contextual re-identification is the dominant residual risk (for example 'my husband', 'Friday dinner', 'that 30k'). Automated detection cannot close it; consent and purpose limitation are the primary controls.
